_law: Owner policy 11 Oct 2026, verbatim: "nothing should be paid ... cut the probes and make them free." Every model call in this repo goes through scripts/lib/free_llm_router.mjs, which reads this file. max_cost_usd is a hard 0: the router refuses any model not listed here, any model whose snapshot pricing is not $0 on every field, any web plugin or :online suffix (billed per request whatever the model), and fails the run loudly if OpenRouter reports a non-zero cost. If no listed model answers, the router returns a named stop and nothing is generated - it never falls back to a paid model. scripts/lib/zero_paid_llm_check.js enforces this file.

policy.probes_disabled_reason: probe disabled by owner policy (11 Oct 2026: nothing should be paid; cut the probes and make them free)

selection_rule: Fetched keyless from https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models, filtered to pricing.prompt == "0" && pricing.completion == "0" (every other pricing field also 0), text output, >= 32k context; ordered strongest instruct model first. Refresh with: node scripts/lib/free_llm_router.mjs --refresh
